tonight.headline: No claim tonight; a tight end and a defence, free, after 01:00
body: Bad news first. You are 0–4, your tight-end slot is empty for Week 5, and the tight end this morning's brief ranked first has lost his quarterback: Lamar Jackson has 'only an outside chance' to play. As set you project 101.9 against 123.3 and ESPN gives you 39%.

Waivers process tonight at 01:00 Mexico City and this is the last brief before they do. Put in no claim. After 01:00 the same players are free: add Brenton Strange for Waller and the Jaguars' defence for the Ravens'. Today, start Tuten in the slot Gordon holds. That takes you to about 118.

case.label: Their side
case.body: Nacua 21.7, Goff 18.5, Kyren Williams 17.9, Jeremiyah Love 15.1 with an ankle Arizona are managing ('not really bothering me', Love), Tee Higgins 14.3 with an adductor injury and 'day-to-day', Watson 13.8, Kittle 13.7. Their defence is Kansas City's, on bye at 0.0, so their number rises when they fix it.

case.label: Your side once it is set
case.body: Taylor 19.0, Lawrence 18.1, Wilson 14.6, Tuten 14.0, Tate 13.6, Golden 12.8, a tight end at 9.7, Myers 8.7 and the Jaguars at 7.7: 118.2.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Barkley practising in full, on your side. Love or Higgins sitting, on theirs.

doFirst.title: Start Tuten in the RB slot, not Gordon
doFirst.subtitle: You benched Barkley today and put Gordon in. The projection has Tuten 3.1 higher, 14.0 to 10.9, and he kicks off first.

case.label: What the check says
case.body: lineup_check.py: start Tuten over Gordon, PROJECTION, 3.1 points. It is the only change outside the coin-flip line. As set you project 101.9; the projection lineup is 105.7.

case.label: Why Tuten
case.body: 17 of Jacksonville's 23 backfield carries on Sunday and two touchdowns called back for penalties (archive; NBC Sports, 4 Oct). Jacksonville have moved from 4.5- to 6.5-point favourites since Monday as Philadelphia's injuries were reported. His brief exit on Sunday has no follow-up and no designation.

case.label: Why not Gordon
case.body: 9 carries for 100 on Sunday, more than half of it on one 53-yard run, after 17 carries the week before with Wright out. Nobody in Miami has named a starter: Hafley's Monday transcript doesn't mention either back. Miami are 7.5-point underdogs and ran 38 plays last week. You spent a claim on him and a start would count toward that thesis; that isn't a reason to give up three points.

case.label: The flex is a coin flip
case.body: Downs is in the flex at 12.1 and the projection prefers Golden at 12.8. That is 0.7, so take Golden and write nothing down. Last week the same kind of flip went against you by 16.9; one week doesn't change the rule.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Gordon outscores Tuten on Sunday (archive).

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Not before Wed 01:00 · then before Sun 07:30
doFirst.title: After waivers clear tonight, add Strange for Waller
doFirst.subtitle: Your tight-end slot projects 0.0. Don't claim. After 01:00 add Strange, or Loveland, or Hockenson, in that order; Andrews drops out of the queue with Lamar Jackson's ankle.

case.label: The hole
case.body: Waller is on bye and he is your only tight end. Free and within a point of each other: T.J. Hockenson 10.4, Brenton Strange 9.7, Colston Loveland 9.7, Mark Andrews 9.6. All are on waivers until Wed 7 Oct at 01:00 Mexico City.

case.label: What changed since this morning
case.body: Andrews was first, on one condition: that Lamar Jackson wasn't ruled out. On Tuesday afternoon Rapoport reported Jackson has 'only an outside chance' to play on a sprained ankle and 'could end up missing multiple games' (SI, 6 Oct, 15:51 ET). Tyler Huntley led no scoring drives in the second half on Sunday. ESPN has already cut Andrews from 10.4 to 9.6. He is out of the queue.

case.label: Why not a claim tonight
case.body: You are 8th of ten, so a claim would cost only two places, and it would still buy nothing: the three are 0.7 apart, a coin flip between any two, and seven managers pick before you. Strange is 16.7% owned and almost certain to clear. Not before Wed 7 Oct, 01:00 Mexico City: until then an add is a waiver claim, and a claim drops you from 8th to last in an order that never resets.

case.label: The order
case.body: Strange first: 7 catches on 8 targets for 95 on 87% of the snaps, with Lawrence healthy and no injury behind it, though it matched his three previous games combined and Philadelphia allow the fifth-fewest points to tight ends. Then Loveland: a team-high 9 targets from Tyson Bagent, who starts again, with no bye until Week 10; he is 91% owned and the least likely to clear. Hockenson last despite the highest number: his 13 targets came with Jefferson out, Jefferson is now questionable, and Minnesota are off in Week 6.

case.label: The drop, and the rule it bends
case.body: Waller. Neither clause of his open thesis has tripped, and you added him on 3 Oct, so both the thesis rule and the churn rule say leave him. This is the exception and I am saying so: Wilson, Kamara, Gordon, Barkley and Rice each have an injured teammate and can't be named, the other seats are starters, and a tight end on bye is a slot at zero. ESPN's season number has Waller at 92.2 against Strange's 127.9.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: The tight end you add scores less on Sunday than another of the three who was still free when you added (archive). For the drop: Waller outscores him in two of Weeks 6 to 8.

doFirst.title: Swap the Ravens' defence for the Jaguars', free
doFirst.subtitle: 4.9 against 7.7, and the gap widened today. Baltimore's game flipped to Atlanta −2.5; Jacksonville get an Eagles offence without Barkley, Bigsby, Smith or Goedert.

case.label: The gap
case.body: The Ravens project 4.9, down from 5.6 this morning and the lowest number in your lineup. Free defences: Cowboys 8.4, Commanders 7.8, Jaguars 7.7, Steelers 7.4. The gap to Jacksonville is 2.8, outside the coin-flip line, which is the bar the strategy sets for a streaming move.

case.label: Why Jacksonville
case.body: Philadelphia went 0 for 12 on third down and threw for 93 yards on Sunday, with Hurts pressured on 57.6% of dropbacks. Since then Bigsby has gone on injured reserve, Barkley is 'likely out', and Smith and Goedert are sidelined for London (Philadelphia Inquirer, 6 Oct). Jacksonville have six interceptions, tied for the league lead, and moved from −4.5 to −6.5. PFN and Sportsnaut rank them 5th for the week and DraftSharks, which had them 22nd this morning, now has them 4th.

case.label: The Cowboys are a coin flip above them
case.body: Dallas project 8.4, which is 0.7 higher, and host Tampa Bay's undrafted rookie quarterback on Thursday; PFN and DraftSharks both rank them 6th. On the projection alone they would be the pick. I stay with Jacksonville because the injury list is reporting I can point to and the two rankings put them a place higher. Either is far better than 4.9. If you take Dallas, they lock on Thursday at 18:15.

case.label: Baltimore's side
case.body: Atlanta have scored 80 points in Michael Penix's two starts and ran for five touchdowns on Monday. Marlon Humphrey and Trey Hendrickson have no return dates. Dropping an 89%-owned defence needs a reason on the record, and that is it: the market is paying for the name.

case.label: The honest risk
case.body: You changed defences on 30 Sep at 08:29 Mexico City, so add after 08:30 on Wednesday and the seat is seven days old. Jacksonville are off in Week 7. Not before Wed 7 Oct, 01:00 Mexico City: until then an add is a waiver claim, and a claim drops you from 8th to last in an order that never resets.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: The Ravens outscore the Jaguars in Week 5 (archive), or Barkley and Smith both play.

whatWentWrong.title: Tonight's waiver run should pass without you
whatWentWrong.lead: Claims process at 01:00 Mexico City. Everything this roster needs, a tight end and a defence, is available as a free add an hour later.

case.label: The evidence
case.body: Three tight ends within 0.7 of each other and four defences within a point; you are 8th in an order that never resets. A claim wins a coin flip at best. The one player every column says to claim, Will Shipley, projects 10.3, below Tuten, Kamara and Gordon, and the strategy never spends priority on a handcuff.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: The second and third cards are marked not to be fired today. If you tap them before 01:00 they become claims.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing before 01:00. If all three tight ends are claimed overnight, which would take three of seven managers ahead of you choosing a tight end, Kenyon Sadiq at 8.9 and Pat Freiermuth at 8.5 are next.

case.label: What it changes

case.label: What would change it

whatWentWrong.title: Lamar Jackson's ankle changed the tight-end order and made the defence swap clearer
whatWentWrong.lead: The morning brief put Andrews first 'unless Lamar Jackson is ruled out'. He isn't ruled out, but 'only an outside chance' is close enough to act on.

case.label: The evidence
case.body: Rapoport via SI, Tuesday 15:51 ET: a minor sprain, not surgical, 'only an outside chance' for Sunday night, and he 'could end up missing multiple games'. CBS still has him day-to-day with the team 'hopeful'; I take the later report. The betting line flipped from Baltimore −2.5 to Atlanta −2.5.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: The second card now names Strange, and the third card's gap grew from 2.1 to 2.8.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Jackson practising on Wednesday or Thursday. Then Andrews is back level with the others, and the Ravens' number recovers some of what it lost.

case.body: 6 catches on a team-high 9 targets for 57 from Tyson Bagent: 11.7 (archive). Targets 2, 3, 4, 9. Bagent starts again at Green Bay and Caleb Williams won't practise this week. Green Bay are without Micah Parsons and lost Edgerrin Cooper for the season. No bye until Week 10.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: One game of volume, with Cole Kmet playing a season-high 73% of the snaps beside him. He had 5 catches in the three games before, two of them with Williams. He is 91.4% owned, the least likely of the three to clear, and you dropped him on 25 Sep.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Wednesday after 01:00, free, if Strange has been claimed.

worthALook.sources: Week 1–4 archive · CBS Sports · SI · Bleacher Nation · packers.com

worthALook.name: T.J. Hockenson
worthALook.lead: Carried. The highest projection of the three, and still last in the queue for two reasons.

case.label: The role
case.body: 13 catches on 13 targets for 119, a 35% share, after 13 targets in the three games before (vikings.com, 4 Oct). DraftKings Network has him at 19 points a game without Jefferson and 10.4 with him. New Orleans are 25th against tight ends.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: ESPN moved Jefferson from OUT to QUESTIONABLE today. And Minnesota are off in Week 6, so dropping Waller for him empties the slot again in five days. RotoWire lists him among its top overall pickups, so he is the likeliest to be claimed tonight.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Only if Strange and Loveland are both gone on Wednesday morning.

worthALook.sources: Week 1–4 archive · vikings.com · DraftKings Network · RotoWire · NFL.com

worthALook.name: Will Shipley
worthALook.lead: The handcuff to your Barkley and every column's top pickup. Not a claim; possibly a free add later in the week.

case.label: The role
case.body: The only healthy back on Philadelphia's roster: Bigsby is on injured reserve and Barkley is 'likely out' for London (Inquirer, 6 Oct). ESPN raised him from 7.8 to 10.3 today. 6 carries for 23 on 47% of the snaps last week.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 10.3 is still below Tuten's 14.0, Kamara's 11.2 and Gordon's 10.9. He has 15 carries all season, the Inquirer names three practice-squad backs who may be elevated, and Jacksonville allow the second-fewest standard points to running backs. Priority never goes on a handcuff, and there is no free seat.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Wednesday's update putting Barkley out beyond London. Then he is worth a free add if he cleared, and the seat question gets asked again on Thursday.

worthALook.sources: Philadelphia Inquirer · NFL.com · RotoWire · Yahoo · Week 4 archive

worthALook.name: Cowboys D/ST
worthALook.lead: New this afternoon: the highest-projected free defence, 0.7 above the Jaguars. The alternative in the third card.

case.label: The role
case.body: Dallas host Tampa Bay on Thursday night. Baker Mayfield (dislocated thumb) is out 'at least three weeks' and Jalon Daniels, an undrafted rookie, threw two interceptions in a 17–14 loss in his first start. PFN and DraftSharks both rank Dallas 6th.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 0.7 over Jacksonville is a coin flip, Dallas gave up 30 to a winless Houston team last week, and I have less reporting on this matchup than on Philadelphia's injury list. They also lock two and a half days earlier.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Wednesday after 01:00, in place of the Jaguars, if you prefer the higher projection or the Jaguars were claimed.

worthALook.sources: ESPN league file · PFN · DraftSharks · CBS Sports · RotoWire

doNotChase.name: Mark Andrews
doNotChase.lead: This morning's first choice at tight end. His quarterback has 'only an outside chance' to play.

case.label: The rise
case.body: The steadiest targets of the free tight ends, 6, 7, 5, 6, and his first touchdown on Sunday. Durham Smythe's season is over, which may add snaps.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 5 catches for 27 yards last week, and Baltimore did not score in the half Tyler Huntley played. ESPN cut him from 10.4 to 9.6 today, below Strange and Loveland.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Jackson practising on Wednesday or Thursday.

doNotChase.sources: SI · FantasyPros · Week 1–4 archive · ESPN league file

doNotChase.name: Joe Mixon
doNotChase.lead: Still the wire's biggest riser, and the reason is gone: Seattle did not sign him.

case.label: The rise
case.body: Monday's reports had him joining Seattle's practice squad. Monday's waiver columns still say so.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: On Tuesday Seattle 'opted against signing' him after his physical (Schefter via NFL.com; FantasyPros, 6 Oct, 14:07 ET). No team, no projection, and he missed all of 2025.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A signing to a 53-man roster and a coach describing a role.

doNotChase.name: Tyreek Hill
doNotChase.lead: Carried, and it touches your own receiver: his agent expects a signing within days, and Kansas City are interested.

case.label: The rise
case.body: Thornton is out 12 to 16 weeks, Rice is hurt, and the Chiefs have contacted Hill's agent. Drew Rosenhaus on Monday: 'I would anticipate Tyreek potentially signing with a team over the next few days.'

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: No signing as of Tuesday afternoon, and he is 'at least a month away from potentially playing' after a knee dislocation. If Kansas City did sign him, some of the targets he took would be Rice's.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A signing, then a practice.

doNotChase.name: Tyler Shough
doNotChase.lead: Carried, and still closed: he projects 3.0 under Lawrence.

case.label: The rise
case.body: An 87%-owned quarterback sitting on your wire, who threw 48 times on Monday.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 15.1 against Lawrence's 18.1, with Minnesota's defence next, ranked 1st to 4th for the week. Heavy reports treatment on both hands; nobody else does.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A week in which he projects two or more above Lawrence. This isn't it.

doNotChase.sources: ESPN league file · Heavy · NBC Sports · DraftSharks

doNotChase.name: Malik Washington
doNotChase.lead: Carried: Yahoo's receiver add of the week, in an offence that threw for 85 yards.

case.label: The rise
case.body: 5 catches on 5 targets for 67, 12.0 (archive); target shares of 28% and 29% (Yahoo, 5 Oct).

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: Targets 8, 5, 10, 5 from a quarterback who was 9 of 17. He would be your sixth receiver and a claim costs priority.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Eight or more targets against Cincinnati, or a different quarterback in Miami.

doNotChase.name: Makai Lemon
doNotChase.lead: Carried: six targets with Smith out, in an offence that threw for 93 yards.

case.label: The rise
case.body: DeVonta Smith is expected to miss multiple games (Inquirer). Lemon played 45 of 61 snaps.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 3 catches on 6 targets for 27, 5.7 (archive). Darius Cooper played 55 snaps and caught both touchdowns.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Eight or more targets in London.

doNotChase.sources: Week 4 archive · NBC Sports Philadelphia · Philadelphia Inquirer

doNotChase.name: Dontayvion Wicks
doNotChase.lead: Carried: Philadelphia's most-used receiver by snaps, and quiet three weeks running.

case.label: The rise
case.body: 56 of 61 snaps with Smith out (NBC Sports Philadelphia).

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 3 catches for 18 on 5 targets, after 5.2 the week before (archive). Hurts threw for 93 yards. Below all four of your healthy receivers.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Eight or more targets in London.

waiverAnalysis.summary: The same eleven names clear the tool's bar as this morning, and at running back and receiver the bar is an artefact: it measures them against Barkley and Rice, whose last week was an injury exit each. Four weeks of data. The only question research turns into a move is at tight end, where the tool doesn't see that Waller is on bye; that is the second card.

rising.name: Keaton Mitchell
rising.roleReason: A three-man rotation by design with Omarion Hampton healthy: snaps 26, 25, 25 on Sunday, and Jim Harbaugh says it 'is best for our team' (Last Word on Sports, 5 Oct). 10 carries and 6 targets without a lead role. The Chargers are off in Week 7.
rising.action: WATCH — a committee third; the trigger is Hampton missing a game
rising.sources: Yahoo · SI · Last Word on Sports

rising.name: Brian Robinson Jr.
rising.roleReason: Bijan Robinson is healthy and ran 19 times for 145. Brian Robinson's three touchdowns, from 4, 8 and 11 yards, came mostly after half-time in a 45–24 win (CBS, 6 Oct). Double-digit carries three weeks running: a real second role behind a healthy starter.
rising.action: WATCH — touchdowns and game script behind a healthy starter

rising.name: MarShawn Lloyd
rising.roleReason: 7 carries for 13 and 5 catches for 36 with a lost fumble; Kaleb Johnson ran 8 times for 42 and fumbled at the goal line. Matt LaFleur: 'a great teacher's the bench' (ClutchPoints). Green Bay are last in rushing and Josh Jacobs is still on the exempt list. You dropped him for Gordon.
rising.action: WATCH — volume at 1.9 yards a carry in a backfield nobody has won

rising.name: Mike Washington Jr.
rising.roleReason: Ashton Jeanty's handcuff: 10 touches for 17 yards while Jeanty had 21 (CBS, 4 Oct). Nothing changed.
rising.action: WATCH — nothing unless Jeanty is hurt

rising.name: Romeo Doubs
rising.roleReason: 9 targets and two touchdowns against Buffalo after Mack Hollins left hurt. A.J. Brown, now a Patriot, is eligible to come off injured reserve in Week 6 and is 'pushing hard to be back ASAP' (Pelissero).
rising.action: WATCH — one nine-target game, with the team's best receiver due back

rising.name: Devaughn Vele
rising.roleReason: 6 catches on 9 targets for 54 and a touchdown while Shough threw 48 times from behind; CBS calls him a high-volume second receiver. Jordyn Tyson is not expected before Week 7 and Week 9 is likelier (Yahoo). The steadiest role on this list.
rising.action: WATCH — a real role; a claim would spend priority on a sixth receiver

rising.name: Khalil Shakir
rising.roleReason: 7 catches on 8 targets for 82 in the game DJ Moore left with an aggravated shoulder sprain; Keon Coleman is the Bill the columns prefer for the extra targets.

rising.name: Tyquan Thornton
rising.roleReason: Dislocated his left ankle on Sunday after 5 catches for 111 and two touchdowns; surgery this week, out 12 to 16 weeks (Rapoport, 5 Oct).
rising.action: WATCH — off the list: out until at least January

rising.name: T.J. Hockenson
rising.roleReason: A 35% target share with Jefferson out; NFL.com calls it 'likely an aberration'. Jefferson is questionable for Sunday and Minnesota are off in Week 6.
rising.action: WATCH — last of the three tight ends for Waller's slot; see the card

rising.name: Michael Mayer
rising.roleReason: 8 catches for 82 beside a healthy Brock Bowers because Kirk Cousins threw 52 times in a 30–27 loss and Jalen Nailor left with a concussion. A second tight end whose volume is pass volume.
rising.action: WATCH — behind the three in the card

rising.name: Brenton Strange
rising.roleReason: 8 targets, 95 yards and 87% of the snaps with no injury behind it (Full Time Fantasy, 5 Oct; PlayerProfiler). Targets have gone 3, 2, 5, 8. No coach has explained it, so it is one game.
rising.action: ADD — free, after waivers clear at 01:00 Wednesday; first in the card's order
rising.sources: Full Time Fantasy · PlayerProfiler · CBS Sports · Week 1–4 archive

settled.title: Week 4 final: 63.7 to 78.2
settled.result: Kyle Pitts added 7.7 for Team 13 on Monday (archive). You lost by 14.5. Kamara 22.8, Tate 21.5, Gordon 18.0 and Golden 11.7 on the bench would have scored 61.7 more than the four slots they could have filled. Barkley and Rice were injury exits; the rest was the projection's lineup.

settled.title: Downs in the flex (the projection lineup, 13.6 to Tate's 11.9)
settled.result: Archive: Downs 4.6, Tate 21.5. A coin flip by projection with no thesis written, and it lost by 16.9.

settled.title: 'If Barkley is ruled out, start Tuten' (the fallback carried since Sunday)
settled.result: Never fired as written: he isn't ruled out. ESPN's 0.0 has replaced it with today's first card. Closed EXPIRED, not RIGHT.

settled.title: 'Shough: a number to read tomorrow' (Monday's brief)
'Darren Waller: do not chase' (Saturday's brief)
settled.result: You added him. Archive: Waller 6.6, Sadiq 0.0. Your move won the week; three days later his bye leaves the slot empty.

settled.title: 'Gordon: bench, leaning against the claim' (Sunday morning's brief)
settled.result: Archive: 18.0 on the bench. The lean was mine and it is withdrawn. He projects 10.9 this week and is in your lineup; today's first card says Tuten.

settled.title: 'Keenan Allen out adds to Downs' share' (3–4 Oct)
settled.result: Allen and Slayton were inactive and Downs drew 4 targets (archive). Closed WRONG.

settled.title: Don't re-claim Hockenson (23 Sep)
settled.result: Closed WRONG on 30 Sep; 24.9 on Sunday (archive). He is last in today's queue for a different reason: a Week 6 bye.

settled.title: Wait on Charbonnet; re-add him free once Seattle activate him (18 Sep)
settled.result: KEI returns added him first. Closed WRONG.

settled.title: Don't claim Tate; take him if he clears (23 Sep)
settled.result: Added free. 21.5 on 12 targets on Sunday (archive), and he starts this week.

settled.title: 'Rice is on bye: start Tate in his slot' (this morning's brief)
settled.result: Done at 11:09 Mexico City. Graded on Sunday.

settled.title: 'Bench Barkley, start Tuten' (this morning's brief)
settled.result: Half done: Barkley is benched, and Gordon, not Tuten, is in the slot. The projection has Tuten 3.1 higher; today's first card.

settled.title: 'Andrews first unless Lamar Jackson is ruled out' (this morning's brief)
settled.result: Its own condition all but fired by 15:51 ET: 'only an outside chance'. Withdrawn before it was acted on; Strange is first.

cannotSee.label: Which tight ends will clear
cannotSee.body: Strange, Loveland and Hockenson are all on waivers until Wed 7 Oct at 01:00 Mexico City. ESPN shows only your own claims, so I can't see who is ahead of you; you are 8th of ten. The card's order is the plan; who is left is Wednesday's fact.

cannotSee.label: Lamar Jackson
cannotSee.body: 'Only an outside chance' is one reporter's line on Tuesday afternoon; CBS's note the same day says day-to-day. He isn't ruled out. Wednesday's practice report is the first hard evidence, and it comes after this brief.

cannotSee.label: Medical results
cannotSee.body: No scan grade is public for Barkley or Rice. Barkley's fuller update is promised for Wednesday, after waivers process, and nobody has reported whether he travels to London on Friday.

cannotSee.label: The two rules the second card bends
cannotSee.body: Dropping Waller breaks the letter of the churn rule (his seat changed on 3 Oct) and of the open-thesis rule (neither clause has tripped). I read a bye at a one-man position as the same thing as a ruling-out for this week. That is my interpretation, not the runbook's words.

cannotSee.label: Jaguars or Cowboys
cannotSee.body: ESPN projects Dallas 0.7 above Jacksonville and I have recommended Jacksonville anyway, on Philadelphia's injury list and two rankings. That is a judgement on a coin flip. I made two searches on the Dallas game and neither returned a usable preview.

cannotSee.label: Intraday projection moves
cannotSee.body: Between this morning's file and this one ESPN moved Kamara from 10.0 to 11.2, Shipley from 7.8 to 10.3, Andrews from 10.4 to 9.6 and the Ravens from 5.6 to 4.9. The last three have news behind them. Kamara's does not, as far as I found.

cannotSee.label: Matchup grades
cannotSee.body: Tiles now use FootballDB's full-PPR table, four games deep. It differs most from the standard table on Jacksonville against backs (7th or 2nd) and Chicago against receivers (5th or 9th).

cannotSee.label: The wire screen
cannotSee.body: Kendre Miller, Isaiah Williams, Antonio Williams, Oronde Gadsden and Tyler Higbee aren't on the published wire, so their availability here is the screen's inference.

cannotSee.label: Reports I couldn't retrieve
cannotSee.body: ESPN's article, injury and depth-chart pages returned empty, so I can't see why its labels on Jefferson and McLaurin changed. Star Tribune, Hogs Haven, Bleeding Green Nation, Stampede Blue, Arrowhead Pride, Field Gulls and Pro Football Rumors were blocked; RotoBaller and several NBC Sports pages gave no article body; FantasyPros' tables did not render. Kellen Moore, Kevin O'Connell, Dan Quinn and Jeff Hafley said nothing on Tuesday that I could find; the newest coach comments are Monday's. Pages were read through a summarising tool, so quotes are close but may not be exact. A Yahoo live-blog headline says Lane Johnson has announced his retirement; the article would not open and the Inquirer lists him only as sidelined.

cannotSee.label: The trade market
cannotSee.body: No trade this run. Barkley and Rice have no scan grades and Team 13's Lamar Jackson is hurt; nothing can be priced.

cannotSee.label: Josh Jacobs
cannotSee.body: Still on the commissioner's exempt list, with no ruling in October; Heavy (6 Oct) says the league is waiting on video evidence. He projects 0.0.
